newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Materials sees sales growth in 97.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Materials sees sales growth in 97.

text.p: Advanced Materials Group says it expects sales growth of between 35 and 40 percent during fiscal 1997 based on existing program orders and commitments.

The company said it has shifted its marketplace strategy to place primary marketing emphasis on the computer and related products niche and that its operations in the three-month period ended February 1997 showed strong results based on this shift in terms of sales mix and gross margins.
The company is also in the process of formulating plans to expand into the Pacific Rim and Great Britain in response to requests from some of its major customers.
Advanced Materials is a maker and fabricator of foams, foils, films and pressure sensitive adhesive components for industrial and medical customers.
